description: devcell project configuration (.devcell.toml) and global defaults (~/.config/devcell/devcell.toml). Generated from internal/cfg.CellConfig; do not edit.

read_only.description: default: false (nil = not set → full access)

cores.description: nix cores (make -j per job); 0 = derived; env: DEVCELL_NIX_CORES

cpus.description: docker --cpus quota (e.g. "8"); "0" = no quota; env: DEVCELL_BUILD_CPUS

max_jobs.description: nix max-jobs; 0 = derived from ceiling; env: DEVCELL_NIX_MAX_JOBS

threads.description: nix download threads (max-substitution-jobs + http-connections); 0 = 128; env: DEVCELL_BUILD_THREADS

background.description: keep VM/container running after shell exit; default: false; env: DEVCELL_BACKGROUND

default_command.description: subcommand to run when `cell` is invoked with no args; env: DEVCELL_DEFAULT_COMMAND

flake.description: enable project-level flake.nix install; default: false (opt-in); env: DEVCELL_FLAKE

gui.description: default: true (nil = not set → true). Deprecated: use [gui] enabled = false instead (replacement: [gui] enabled)

hostname.description: override container hostname; default: computed "cell-<basename>-<bunk>"; env: DEVCELL_HOSTNAME

kvm.description: pass the daemon host's /dev/kvm into the container so QEMU gets hardware accel instead of TCG; default: false; env: DEVCELL_KVM

libvirt_path_map.description: container prefix -> host prefix rewrites for domain XML paths (CELL-375); empty = CLI runs on the host. Deprecated: remove it; the libvirt engine was retired, run `cell --engine winkit` on the macOS host instead

libvirt_uri.description: retired libvirt engine; parsed only so the deprecation warning fires. Deprecated: remove it; the libvirt engine was retired, run `cell --engine winkit` on the macOS host instead

mac_address.description: MAC for the container's NIC (XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX); pinned across restarts for infra-side identity persistence. Honored on user-defined bridge networks (devcell uses --network devcell-network). Empty → docker auto-assigns a random MAC per launch.

mcps.description: shorthand MCP servers to enable: ["playwright", "aws-api"] (merged into [mcp] enabled)

modules.description: extra nix modules to compose on top of stack

nixhome.description: deprecated: use [nix] nixhome instead. Deprecated: use [nix] nixhome = "~/dev/home" instead (replacement: [nix] nixhome)

os.description: guest OS: "linux" (default), "macos", "windows" or "winpe"; derives engine when [cell].engine is unset

packages.description: nix packages from the stable channel, baked into the image at build time

per_cell_image.description: tag user image per cell instead of per stack; default: false

qemu_cpus.description: deprecated spelling of winkit_cpus; merged into it by LoadFile. Deprecated: use [cell] winkit_cpus = 4 instead (replacement: [cell] winkit_cpus)

qemu_disk_size_gb.description: no effect; parsed only so the deprecation warning fires. Deprecated: remove it; it has no effect

qemu_display.description: deprecated, no effect; parsed only so the deprecation warning fires. Deprecated: remove it; it has no effect

qemu_memory_gb.description: deprecated spelling of winkit_memory_gb; merged into it by LoadFile. Deprecated: use [cell] winkit_memory_gb = 8 instead (replacement: [cell] winkit_memory_gb)

qemu_project_sync.description: retired with the libvirt engine; parsed only so the deprecation warning fires. Deprecated: remove it; the libvirt engine was retired and it was the only engine that synced the project

qemu_ssh_host.description: deprecated, no effect; parsed only so the deprecation warning fires. Deprecated: remove it; it has no effect

qemu_ssh_port.description: deprecated spelling of winkit_ssh_port; merged into it by LoadFile. Deprecated: use [cell] winkit_ssh_port = 2222 instead (replacement: [cell] winkit_ssh_port)

qemu_windows_iso.description: deprecated spelling of winkit_windows_iso; merged into it by LoadFile. Deprecated: use [cell] winkit_windows_iso = "~/Downloads/Win11_ARM64.iso" instead (replacement: [cell] winkit_windows_iso)

registry.description: container registry; default: DefaultRegistry; env: DEVCELL_REGISTRY

stale_warning.description: CELL-391 "cell is behind — parallel reality" nudge at start; default: true; env: DEVCELL_STALE_WARN

tart_oci_image.description: OCI base image for tart VMs; default: DefaultTartOCIImage; env: DEVCELL_TART_OCI_IMAGE

tart_ssh_host.description: SSH host for tart engine; default: "localhost"; env: DEVCELL_TART_SSH_HOST

tart_ssh_key.description: path to SSH private key for tart; env: DEVCELL_TART_SSH_KEY

tart_ssh_port.description: SSH port for tart engine; default: 22; env: DEVCELL_TART_SSH_PORT

tart_ssh_user.description: SSH user for tart engine; default: "admin"; env: DEVCELL_TART_SSH_USER

thin.description: thin image mode; default: true; disable with thin=false or DEVCELL_THIN=0. Deprecated: remove it; thin is the only build mode

vagrant_box.description: retired vagrant engine; parsed only so the deprecation warning fires. Deprecated: remove it; the vagrant engine was removed, use [cell] os = "macos" for a Tart VM

vagrant_provider.description: retired vagrant engine; parsed only so the deprecation warning fires. Deprecated: remove it; the vagrant engine was removed, use [cell] os = "macos" for a Tart VM

winkit_cpus.description: winkit VM vCPUs; default: 4; env: DEVCELL_WINKIT_CPUS

winkit_memory_gb.description: winkit VM RAM in GB; default: 4; env: DEVCELL_WINKIT_MEMORY_GB

winkit_ssh_port.description: SSH port for winkit engine; default: allocated per bunk; env: DEVCELL_WINKIT_SSH_PORT

winkit_windows_iso.description: path to Windows ARM64 ISO for winkit engine; env: DEVCELL_WINKIT_WINDOWS_ISO

cpu_limit.description: docker --cpus quota (e.g. "2"); "0" = no quota; env: DEVCELL_DOCKER_CPU_LIMIT

model.description: the provider's own model ID, no prefix

default.description: Deprecated: use [llm] provider = "openrouter" and model = "deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro" instead (replacement: [llm] model)

use_ollama.description: Deprecated keys, migrated into the fields above by migrateLLM.. Deprecated: use [llm] provider = "ollama" instead (replacement: [llm] provider)

enabled.description: MCP server names to enable (e.g. ["aws-api", "terraform"]). Deprecated: use [cell] mcps = ["playwright"] instead (replacement: [cell] mcps)

mise.description: [mise] — keys map to MISE_<UPPER_KEY> env vars

image.description: nix core image for thin builds; default: DefaultNixImage; env: DEVCELL_NIX_IMAGE

nixhome.description: local nixhome path; overridden by DEVCELL_NIXHOME_PATH env

documents.description: 1Password document names to resolve via `op item get`

items.description: deprecated: use documents (kept for backwards compat)

node.description: name → npm version or range; "*" = latest

npm.description: Deprecated [packages.npm], merged into Node by mergePackagesNode.. Deprecated: use [packages.node] "prettier" = "^3" instead (replacement: [packages.node])

forward.description: port mappings: "3000", "8080:3000". Deprecated: use [cell] ports = ["3000", "8080:3000"] instead (replacement: [cell] ports)

publish_ip.description: host interface for `docker run -p`; default "0.0.0.0". Applies to VNC, RDP, and all forward entries.

documents.description: 1Password document names to resolve via `op item get`

op.description: alias for [secrets.onepassword]; TOML-only, not a nix option
